caption: Contact R-precision on the legacy 554-protein benchmark (left, where every published MarinFold number lives) and on exp245's eval-test (right, 217 natural FoldBench monomers held out and decontaminated at 30 % identity). Error bars are 95 % bootstrap intervals over proteins. The two sequence-KNN nulls copy the contacts of each protein's ten nearest training sequences, out of the corpus each model family actually trained on.
